name: Hacchake Ayayo-san
original_name: はっちゃけあやよさん
source:
Hacchake Ayayo-san is a very short visual novel starring Ayayo, a seventeen-year-old girl who finds a part-time job as a clerk in Mr. Suzuki's shop. Further plot is dedicated to her sexual encounters with customers and the owner.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hacchake-ayayo-san]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《调皮的绫代小姐》是一部篇幅极短的视觉小说，主角是17岁的泽岛绫代。她在铃木先生的商店找到了一份店员兼职，此后的故事便围绕她与顾客及店主发生的性关系展开。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hacchake-ayayo-san]Moby Games[/url]]
